For the the artifacts in Dungeons, see MCD:Artifact.

An artifact is an equippable item with a special ability that expends souls to be activated. This ability may involve harming enemies, applying a negative or positive effect to a target, or summoning a pet. Each hero can only equip one artifact at the start of the game, but quickly gains their second and third slots at levels 5 and 10 respectively.

Usage

Each artifact expends a different quantity of souls, and cannot be used when below their minimum quantity. When the soul requirement is unmet, the artifact appears grayed out and cannot be used. Upon usage, artifacts trigger their innate ability over either a duration of time or instantly, after which they go on cooldown.
